messages.guide.title: Notices
messages.guide.intro.title: Hello
messages.guide.intro:
Hello. I’m Enomoto from Yohaku, a small software publisher.
I came across the screen you’re building and wanted to get in touch. When it’s ready, would you let us sell it?
messages.guide.instructions.title: Tools for building a screen
messages.guide.instructions:
Thank you. First, you’ll need a tool for building screens.
Work through “Upgrades” below, and you’ll be able to build that tool too. There’s no rush.

messages.intro.note:
Production notes.txt

What I want to make: software that grows from a screen with one button into my own computer.
The screen with one button is already finished.

This screen is made of pixels.
Press the button to create one pixel.
Collect pixels to build Border, Color, and Font.
Everything I build becomes part of this screen.

Once it has grown, release it as a product for people to use.
Goal: Finish building this screen and release it as v1.0.
Someday, I want to be able to make anything with this one screen.
messages.release.confirm.title: Release the prototype
messages.release.confirm:
Everything is ready. The shipped version belongs to your customers, so you will rebuild the next version for the improved hardware.
Your pixels and current parts and apps will be cleared. Completed sets remain as older-version documents, alongside hardware, tokens, and plugins.
Finally, please choose a name for your product.
messages.release.needRevenue: 256 colors costs {dollars} dollars. Build a little more before shipping.
messages.release.sales.title: First sales
messages.release.sales:
The first day sold better than I expected. Thank you.
You can improve the screen’s performance with this revenue. Start with more colors: 256 colors can display a desktop.
messages.guide.return.title: The next version
messages.guide.return:
Welcome back. You are starting from the first screen, but there are many more colors this time.
Customers have told us they want to use other apps alongside it. Let’s make v1.0 a version that works as a desktop.
